description: Starts editing an existing commitment in one of the user’s funds: the fields they name. The assistant puts the edit, and anything it changes about sent capital calls, to the user for confirmation before anything is written.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_edit_commitment
title: Edit an investor’s commitment
